name: MySQL
shortInfo: Sync data from your data warehouse to MySQL
brief: Load data directly from your data warehouse to MySQL without any code
about:
MySQL Cluster enables users to meet the database challenges of next generation web, cloud, and communications services with uncompromising scalability.  
  
Learn more about [MySQL.](https://www.mysql.com/)
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/my-sql/syncs/export.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve data from a user specified datawarehouse to the MySQL.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/my-sql/index.html) here.
